title: Historical performance campaigns were compared to the current engine profile and upgrade baseline

source_observation.environment: Clean-tree control-plane executor regression using immutable 3.2.2/C24 and 3.2.3/C30 campaign records
source_observation.fact: Assert-MIRCPPerformanceCampaignAuthority compared historical immutable campaigns to the current 2.1.13 target profile and current upgrade row. The historical records correctly bind Factorio 2.1.12 and their own exact release baselines, so the control-plane self-test failed before executing any current performance staging behavior.

reproducer.expected: Historical immutable campaigns bind their declared target-line engine version and exact declared baseline, while a current target campaign remains bound to the current profile and upgrade row.
reproducer.observed: The 3.2.2/C24 campaign declared 2.1.12 and baseline 3.2.1, but was rejected against current 2.1.13 and baseline 3.2.3 despite all candidate and package identities matching.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; historical qualification authority interpretation only
